strings: r_c0 gently helps m_c lie down in one of the spare nests in the medicine den. It's better than letting {PRONOUN/m_c/object} stumble around the camp.
m_c feels a little bit dizzy from the tiredness weighing {PRONOUN/m_c/object} down.
Due to how overtired m_c's been, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} stood up and needed to sit back down with a spinning head.
